recognize_zh: 視野內大量紅血球一端拉長變尖，呈淚滴或梨形（dacrocyte），部分尾端細長；多數細胞仍保有中央淡染，這種大量淚滴細胞是原發性骨髓纖維化等骨髓浸潤性疾病的典型血片表現。
features: Numerous teardrop/pear-shaped red cells with a single tapered tail
Some dacrocytes show long, thin, sharply pointed tails
Marked poikilocytosis with admixed oval and elongated red cells
Most red cells are normochromic with preserved central pallor
No leukocytes or nucleated red cells in this field; platelets not clearly seen
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis dominated by numerous dacrocytes (teardrop cells), several with elongated tapering tails, admixed with ovalocytes. Red cells are largely normochromic with preserved central pallor. No leukocytes or nucleated red cells are present in this field to assess for leukoerythroblastosis. In a patient with splenomegaly and marrow fibrosis, these findings are consistent with a myelophthisic picture such as primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia shows occasional dacrocytes but is dominated by microcytic, hypochromic target cells with a high RBC count.
Morphologically identical dacrocytes; separation requires marrow biopsy showing tumor cells rather than MPN-type megakaryocytes and fibrosis.
Artifactual teardrops have tails all pointing in the same direction, whereas true dacrocytes point in random directions as here.
Can show teardrops but has oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with an elevated MCV.
